<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_INQ_IP" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/inq-ip">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DataRequest" name="Transaction data request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_TransactionData" name="Transaction data"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RequestRejected" name="Request rejected"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_INQ_IP">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_INQ" name="INQ"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_IP" name="IP" processRef="Process_IP"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DataRequest" name="Transaction data request" sourceRef="Participant_INQ" targetRef="StartEvent_DataRequestReceived" messageRef="Message_DataRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_TransactionData" name="Transaction data" sourceRef="SendTask_TransmitData" targetRef="Participant_INQ" messageRef="Message_TransactionData"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RequestRejected" name="Request rejected" sourceRef="SendTask_RejectRequest" targetRef="Participant_INQ" messageRef="Message_RequestRejected"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_IP" name="IP process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_DataRequestReceived" name="Transaction data request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_DataRequest" messageRef="Message_DataRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRequest" name="Check request"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Examination_Split" name="Examination outcome"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_TransmitData" name="Transmit transaction data"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_RejectRequest" name="Reject request"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_DataTransmitted" name="Data transmitted"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RequestRejected" name="Request rejected"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceivedToCheck" sourceRef="StartEvent_DataRequestReceived" targetRef="Task_CheckRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckToGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckRequest" targetRef="Gateway_Examination_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToTransmit" name="Examination positive" sourceRef="Gateway_Examination_Split" targetRef="SendTask_TransmitData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToReject" name="Examination negative" sourceRef="Gateway_Examination_Split" targetRef="SendTask_RejectRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TransmitToEnd" sourceRef="SendTask_TransmitData" targetRef="EndEvent_DataTransmitted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RejectToEnd" sourceRef="SendTask_RejectRequest" targetRef="EndEvent_RequestRejected"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
